0022600172.text: The Miami Heat (2-4, fifth in the Southeast and 10th in the East) visit the Los Angeles Lakers (4-2, first in the Pacific and seventh in the West) for Miami's seventh game of the season, with the Heat on a two-game winning streak and the Lakers coming off a one-game losing streak. Lakers forward Adou Thiero is out with knee inflammation. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Miami lost the 2025-26 series 0-2, including a 134-126 defeat in Miami on March 19.
